sentences.text: The claimants are before this Court seeking enhancement challenging the judgment and award in LACA No.129/2015 modifying the judgment and award in LAC No.476/2002 and awarding enhance compensation of Rs.88,000/- per acre as against Rs.24,000/- per acre awarded by the Reference Court with all Statutory benefits.

2. The claimant /appellant is the owner of land Sy.No.5/A measuring 6 acre 22 guntas situated Yankanchi village, taluka and District Kalaburagi, under preliminary notification of Land Acquisition Act (for short "Act") dated 26.05.1987 for the purpose of Lower Bennethora Project respondents have acquired the said land.
The SLAO- NC: 2024:KHC-K:3914 respondent No.1 determined the market value and passed award at Rs.4,000/- per acre, as dry land.

On protest the claimant/appellant preferred reference under Section 28(A) of the Act and the matter was referred to the Civil Court in LAC No.476/2002.
3.
The Reference Court enhanced the compensation of the acquired land at Rs.24,000/- per acre as dry land with all statutory benefits.
Appeal was preferred in LACA No.129/2015 seeking further enhancement of compensation by the claimants.
The First Appellate Court determined and enhanced the compensation @ Rs.88,000/- per acre for the dry land.

Seeking further enhancement,
the claimants are before this Court.

4. Heard Sri Shivashankar H., learned counsel for the claimant/appellant, Sri Sudarshan M.,
learned counsel for respondent No.3 and Sri Rajkumar A Korwar., learned HCGP for the State.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:3914 5.

Learned counsel for the appellant/claimant would submit that the land is situated at Yankanchi village, taluka and District Kalaburagi, and it is dry and the acquisition was for the purpose of Chandrashetty vs The Special Land And Anr on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186930801/
2 Bennethora project, the Apex Court in the Civil Appeal No.6159/2021 dated 10.05.2022 in the case of Karnataka Neeravari Nigam ltd Vs. Revappa (D) by Lrs (Revappa) and others has awarded compensation of Rs.1,20,814/- per acre for dry land pertaining to the village of Harikanchi, which was acquired by the respondent under the notification dated 11.04.1985 for the same project.
6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further lands in question are acquired under the 4(1) notification dated 26.05.1987 and if the compensation is calculated by adding 8% escalation p.a as awarded by the Apex Court, the amount would be Rs.1,40,144/- and therefore sought to fix the market value Rs.1,40,144/- per acre with all statutory benefits.

7. Learned counsel for the respondent do not dispute that the judgment of the Apex Court in the NC:
2024:KHC-K:3914 Revappa's case stated supra is applicable to the present facts.

8. The Apex Court in Revappa's case stated supra has quantified the compensation at Rs.1,20,814/-
per acre for dry land to the lands acquired by the respondent situated at Harikanchi village for Bennethora project under the 4(1) notification dated 11.04.1985.
It is not dispute that Yankanchi village and Harikanchi village are situated in the same taluka and District Kalaburagi and are adjacent and same are acquired by the respondent for the same project.
The land in Revappa's case stated supra is squarely applicable in an exemplar to the present case.

9. The land in question is acquired under the notification dated 26.05.1987, by adding an escalation for 2 years @ 8% to the amount of Rs.1,20,814/-, it would come to Rs.1,40,144/- and accordingly the claimants are entitled for Rs.1,40,144/- with all statutory benefits.

Accordingly, this Court pass the following:
NC: 2024:KHC-K:3914 ORDER I.
The appeal stands allowed in part.
II. The judgment and award of the First appellate Court is modified the compensation is enhanced from Rs.88,000/- to Rs.1,40,144/- per acre.
The claimants are entitled for all the statutory benefits.
III. The deficit Court fee, if any, to be paid by the appellant within a period of 4 weeks.
IV. The period of delay before the First Appellate Court and this Court, the claimants are not entitled for interest for the said period.
